## Detailed Biography
Mohammed Rounaq Ali (widely known as Md Rounaq Ali) is an Indian software engineer and computer science undergraduate at Nalla Narasimha Reddy Education Society's Group of Institutions (NNRESGI), Hyderabad. He has established a formidable engineering track record across full-stack development, mobile applications, and generative AI architectures.

### Major Production Deployments & Software Architecture
1. **ClaimTrackr — AI-Powered Automated Insurance Claims Processing System**
   - **Repository:** https://github.com/md-rounaq-ali/AI-Powered-Automated-Insurance-Claims-Processing-System
   - **Role:** Core AI & Backend Developer (Team of 4)
   - **Tech Stack:** Python, Flask, Ollama (Llama 3.2, Llama 3.2-Vision), LangChain, FAISS, sqlite-vec, PyPDF2, Tesseract OCR, TailwindCSS, SQLite.
   - **Key Architectural Contributions:**
     - Architected the Policy RAG pipeline using LangChain and FAISS 768-dim vector embeddings with an SQLite context cache, eliminating hallucinations across 100% of adjudication test cases.
     - Engineered a multi-factor vector duplicate detection engine using `sqlite-vec` (>70% duplicate threshold, >75% semantic policy exclusion matching).
     - Built an SSE streaming API cutting adjudication latency from 3–14 days to under 15 seconds per claim (>99% reduction).
     - Implemented multimodal document OCR fallback (PyPDF2 + Tesseract + Llama 3.2-Vision), achieving 100% correct adjudication across 6 benchmark cases.

2. **NexBrief — Daily IT Intelligence Newsletter Platform**
   - **Live Platform:** https://nexbrief-news.onrender.com/
   - **GitHub:** https://github.com/md-rounaq-ali/nexbrief-daily-it-intelligence-platform
   - **Overview:** India's dedicated IT newsletter delivering curated technical intelligence across 8 domains daily to 100+ active subscribers with 99.9% uptime. Reduced page load times by 40% and API overhead by 60% via caching.

3. **VoxCalc — AI-Inspired Computational Suite**
   - **Live Demo:** https://md-rounaq-ali.github.io/VoxCalc/
   - **GitHub:** https://github.com/md-rounaq-ali/VoxCalc
   - **Overview:** Flutter mathematical computation suite featuring dynamic voice NLP computation, live camera formula scanning via Google ML Kit OCR (95% accuracy), and interactive coordinate graphing running at 60 FPS across Android, iOS, and Web.

4. **Block Crush — High-Performance Mobile Puzzle Game**
   - **Live Demo:** https://md-rounaq-ali.github.io/block-crush-game/
   - **GitHub:** https://github.com/md-rounaq-ali/block-crush-game
   - **Overview:** Achieves sustained 60 FPS on low-end 2GB RAM devices via RepaintBoundary widget isolation, Provider reactive state management, and Lottie animations, cutting frame drops by 80%.

5. **FinTrack — Full-Stack Personal Finance Tracker**
   - **GitHub:** https://github.com/md-rounaq-ali/personal-finance-tracker
   - **Overview:** Python Flask & MySQL web app with 6 interactive Chart.js dashboards, session authentication, and 3NF relational database.

6. **Weather Intel — Real-Time Weather Application**
   - **Live Demo:** https://md-rounaq-ali.github.io/weather-app/
   - **GitHub:** https://github.com/md-rounaq-ali/weather-app
   - **Overview:** Flutter weather intelligence client with debounced OpenWeather REST API logic reducing network payload by 15%.
